items.title: Submit Widerspruch against the cost-coverage denial
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch erhoben werden.
items.computation: Letter dated Monday 14.04.2025 (posting day, no separate 'zur Post gegeben' date stated). Sender is a statutory health insurer (Krankenkasse), a social-law body under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X, posted after 1 Jan 2025, so it counts as delivered on the 4th calendar day after posting: 14.04.2025 + 4 days = 18.04.2025 (Friday, Karfreitag). Unlike tax offices, delivery for social-law bodies does NOT move even if that day is a holiday, so delivery = 18.04.2025. The one-month Widerspruch period (§ 84 SGG) runs from the delivery day and ends, per §§ 187 Abs.1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB analog, on the day in the following month with the same number: 18.05.2025 (Sunday). Since the last day of the period falls on a Sunday, it moves to the next working day (§ 26 Abs. 3 SGB X, § 193 BGB): Monday 19.05.2025, which is not a holiday in NRW.
